label: Address-change processing deadline
note: For existing registrations, address changes received at least 15 days before Election Day must be processed in time. Missing this processing date does not automatically mean you are ineligible: check your record and ask your county Board of Elections where and how to vote.

label: New-registration deadline
note: New registrations must be received by this date for the Nov 3 election. Existing voters can check their registration. Address changes have separate processing rules; missing that processing date does not automatically mean a voter is ineligible.

label: Last day to request a mail ballot (online or by mail)
note: Online and mailed early-mail/absentee ballot applications must be received by this date.

label: Early voting begins
note: Nine days of early voting. In New York City you're assigned one early voting site — look yours up, it can be different from your Election Day poll site.

label: Early voting ends
note: Last day to vote early, at your assigned early voting site.

label: Last day to request a mail ballot in person
note: If you missed the online/mail deadline, you can still request in person at your county BOE office.

label: ELECTION DAY
note: General Election. Polls open 6 AM – 9 PM. Vote at your assigned poll site.

label: Mail ballot receipt deadline
note: Postmark your mail ballot by Election Day (Nov 3) — earlier is safer. It must reach your county Board of Elections by Nov 10 to count.
